text:
maria: Morning — quick triage. Queue is at 23 tickets (3 critical: #4721, #4723, #4727). Yesterday I cleared the backlog for billing webhooks and updated two macros. Blocker: waiting on infra confirm for the deploy that fixes #4723. Today: will finish the macro rollouts and pair on the billing follow-up.

alex: Thanks — I can be on the infra confirm. I saw the failing job in CI, looks like the new DB migration is held behind the safety flag. Pinging infra: @devon can you double-check the rollout window? :eyes:

devon: On it. Window looks clear but need to coordinate with a Dedicated infra patch at 11:30am PT. If we push after that, rollback gets messy. Recommend we target 12:15pm PT and keep a one-hour monitor.

maria: 12:15pm PT works. Sam, can you update the status macro to reflect the temp workaround for #4727 so CS has something to paste?

sam: Yup. Drafted a short macro to note the workaround + ETA. Preview:
```
We are investigating intermittent failures in embedding generation for some customers. Workaround: reduce batch_size to 8. ETA for fix: ~2 hours. Ticket: #4727
```
I'll push it in a bit and add to the pasteboard.

lina: Quick FYI — ticket #4710 (user reported incorrect token counts) is resolved in prod and I left a note on the ticket. No regression on other customers.

maria: Nice. For the macros I updated yesterday, I left comments on two PRs: `support/macro-clarify` and `support/macro-embed-workaround`. @alex if you can review `support/macro-clarify` before 10am that'd be great.

alex: Will do a quick pass before 10. If anything, I'll mark as `needs-copy` and tag product.

devon: Also flag: incident bot noticed an uptick in 5xxs around 02:14 UTC — looks related to a spike in long-running requests to the hosted API. Not widespread but worth watching.

qa-bot: [automation] Added run: `support/triage-smoke` — will re-run replay on affected traces at 10:05 UTC.

maria: Thanks. Action items summary:
- devon: confirm deploy schedule and watch 12:15pm PT patch
- alex: review `support/macro-clarify` by 10am
- sam: publish workaround macro and add pasteboard link
- lina: follow up on #4721 owner and ensure customer update
- qa-bot: run smoke replay at 10:05 UTC and share results

If anyone is taking a shift swap today, post here. Otherwise I'll post a noon update with queue count and any change to ETAs. :thumbsup:

alex: I might need to swap the 2pm shift — @lina if you can cover the late check that would help.

lina: I can cover 2pm. Thanks.

sam: Macro published: link=https://pasteboard.example.com/p/3h4k — added to ticket templates.

maria: Perfect. I'll post the noon pulse, include the deploy time and the macro link.

devon: I'll post a heads-up in #eng-runtime 10 minutes before deploy.

maria: Great — closing thread for now, will update after deploy monitor.
